entries.title: Raft

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original full release and the best capture/input route. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S ports are valid current console routes with cross-play, but they do not add sourced exclusive story content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Raft on Steam for Windows PC and play the current Final Chapter build. Use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S only if a console/cross-play route is preferred.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC full release after Early Access, including The Final Chapter content.
all_releases.reason: primary: original full-release route and best capture/input platform.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 console release with online co-op and cross-play support.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S release with 4K, 60 fps+, cloud saves, and cross-play support documented on the Xbox store route.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but PC remains the preferred capture/input platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The current console ports do not add exclusive content; PC remains the original complete capture/input route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Final Chapter is the 1.0/full-release content update, not a separate game entry. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are later ports/access routes, not remasters.
